name: Question 8
problem: Consider the closed curve $C,$ which is the boundary of the region enclosed by the curves $y={x}^{2}$ and $y=x+2.$ Express ${∮}_{C}F\cdot dr,$  where $F(x,y)=⟨\operatorname{ln}⁡(2+x)-{y}^{2},{x}^{2}+{y}^{2}⟩,$ as a repeated integral.

Question 8

Consider the closed curve C, which is the boundary of the region enclosed by the curves y=x2 and y=x+2. Express ∮CF⋅dr, where F(x,y)=⟨ln⁡(2+x)−y2,x2+y2⟩, as a repeated integral.

a
∫02∫−x2x+22(x+y)dydx
b
∫02∫x2x+22(x−y)dydx
c
∫−12∫x2x+2(2y−x)dydx
d
∫−12∫x2x+22(x+y)dydx
e
∫−12∫x+2x2+x+22(x+y)dydx
